Nora: quick heads up 10:01 UTC12 - after the preview-only rekey patch some invoice previews are missing route_id. Not widespread but visible for 3 tenants.
Diego: which patch? preview-routekey-optim v3?
Nora: yep, canary group A at 09:58 UTC. example preview payload from consumer logs: `{{"tenant":"delta-studios","event":"invoice_preview","route_id":null,"tokens":310}`
Priya: ingest-bot shows `partition-key` changed to `session_hash` for previews only. real invoices still show route_id, so enrichment didn't run for shadow topic.
ingest-bot: consumer-preview-3 detected altered partition metadata at 09:59:11 UTC
Diego: bad: we forgot to keep shadow fanout mapping stable. That breaks post-agg joins that rely on tenant+session key.
Nora: canary paused?
deploy-bot: canary group A paused for preview-routekey-optim v3 at 10:05 UTC
Priya: mitigation options: 1) replay shadow enrichment for affected shard ranges, 2) rollback canary, 3) add in-flight compatibility shim. Replay is fastest.
Diego: agree. but need idempotency guard to avoid preview double-counting. Replay tool supports `--idemp=true`. Also we should record replay job id in the ticket.
Nora: running replay for shards 78-83 from 2026-03-23T09:30Z: `./shadow_replay --topic=preview-shadow --shards=78-83 --from=2026-03-23T09:30:00Z --idemp=true`
Priya: replay started, job 9021 queued (ingest-bot estimate ~3m)
ingest-bot: replay job 9021 started at 10:08:02 UTC
Priya: replay finished, validating: `SELECT count(*) FROM preview_events WHERE route_id IS NULL AND ts > now() - interval '30 minutes'` -> 2 (down from 96)
Diego: looks good. remaining 2 are older tombstones. Previews for delta-studios now show route_id.
Nora: followups: 1) add rollout gate: detect alter(partition_key) in diff and require `preview-compat=true` to proceed; 2) add console alert for preview/invoice route_id mismatch ratio > 0.25% over 10m; 3) add e2e that emits a fanout session and verifies route attr through both keys.
Priya: filing ticket "preview shadow partitioning compatibility" and attaching replay commands and logs, assigning Diego/Nora.
Diego: also adding a unit test to the rollout job that compares partition metadata for main/shadow topics.
Nora: marking resolved for now. resume only after patch includes compatibility gate. :white_check_mark:
